text:
message: my children are hungry
reply: 🙇 In the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Spirit ❤️✝️🕊️ : May the LORD feed your children! Amen! 🙏
reply: 🙏 Sorry, I have nothing that I can give you at this time. According to the desire of the LORD: May the LORD provide and may the LORD lead you to someone who will abundantly provide whatever you ask the same day you ask.
